The '''Bacrana system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The system consisted of five [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Asteroid field/Legends|belt]] orbiting a yellow [[Star/Legends|sun]] also known as [[Bacrana (star)|Bacrana]]. Three of the planets were "small" [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]], one was a superheated rock, and the second planet was the terrestrial world of [[Bacrana/Legends|Bacrana]]. The system was also home to the [[Bacrana Shipyards]].
